bio: Ozmol can see the future. He sees it in the flicker of a candle flame or the molten bubble of a fuming cauldera. It is never a comforting vision, with him often seeing something burning horribly, or a great change forged in fire. Yet the flames never lie, and Ozmol takes no pleasure in recounting his grim prognostications. Well, maybe a little.
